info.description: Initial contract baseline derived from mounted server routers and route tests. See contracts/README.md for explicit completeness limits.

200.description: Current organization, or null when unassigned

put.summary: Update organization settings (HR admin or above)
put.description: service_desk_project_id must be an active project in this organization. Null clears the setting; omission preserves it.

403.description: Organization admin permission required

post.description: Creates a keyed copy in the platform organization's Service Desk project, or General, in its initial workflow state. Returns 201 even if creating the copy fails; the failure is logged.

400.description: Invalid ticket input or missing tenant context

patch.description: Platform-tenant operators can update status. Open and acknowledged map to the initial state; in_progress maps to the first in_progress-category state; resolved and closed map to the first non-cancelled done-category state (sort_order then id). Sync is one way, bypasses transitions and records service_desk_sync history as a system actor. A cancelled copy is never synced again. Owners may only edit title, description and priority while open.

400.description: Invalid update or owner ticket no longer open

403.description: Not platform tenant or ticket owner

delete.summary: Delete a Service Desk ticket, retaining its platform copy
delete.description: Platform-tenant operators may delete a ticket; an owner may cancel their own open ticket. The copy moves to Cancelled and receives a service_desk_deleted system history note. A Done copy stays Done and receives only the note. The copy and its time/history are never deleted.

cookieAuth.name: token
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly JWT cookie used by web and desktop clients

bearerAuth.description: JWT returned by auth flows for native mobile clients

CsrfHeader.name: X-Requested-With
CsrfHeader.description: Required on mutating /api requests. AINO is preferred; WorkPulse is accepted for compatibility.

service_desk_project_id.description: Active project in the same organization; null selects General fallback.

action.description: Includes service_desk_sync and service_desk_deleted for system-authored Service Desk events.

FreeFormValue.description: Response shape is not yet exhaustively modeled in this baseline

token.description: Mirrors the JWT cookie for native clients

pushVersion.description: v2 alert links, v3 Android reactions, v4 Android group avatars. Missing/unknown versions register as legacy v1.

switched_at.description: First publication timestamp; retained after emergency switch-back. Initial publication cannot be repeated.

migration_key.description: Original migration target key, preserved for audit.

count.description: Active, non-Cancelled organization-wide occupancy for this workflow state; matches the write guard.

link.description: Relative web path to open on tap (e.g. /tasks?task=1, /manager?tab=approvals&request=5, /attendance#leaves); null when there is no destination.

timestamp.description: Client event time in Unix milliseconds.

ticket_key.description: Stored, org-unique ticket key. Never recomputed from a project's current key.

issue_key.description: Legacy field retained for older clients; equal to ticket_key.

planned_date.description: Date-only planning metadata. Never affects backlog membership.

completed_at.description: Derived by the database from the workflow-state category. Clients never write it.

estimated_minutes.description: Planned effort in minutes. Shown against logged_minutes.

logged_minutes.description: Minutes logged by timers started from this task. Rolls into the timesheet.

key_aliases.description: Former ticket keys that still resolve to this ticket.

key_alias.description: True when the requested ticket key was a former key.

requested_key.description: The key used to fetch the ticket, which may be an alias.

client.description: The native surface asking for a code. Only a webview may redeem one.

code.description: Single-use, expires within 60 seconds. The bearer token never enters the web page.

presented_by.description: A native client presenting a code is rejected.

estimated.description: Planned minutes. 0 when the task is unestimated.

percent.description: Logged as a percentage of estimated; 0 when unestimated.

minutes.description: Minutes added to the task by this stop.

floorSeconds.description: Exact worked seconds up to the server's now at response time (open session included). Clients anchor live timers on this.

breakSeconds.description: Exact break seconds up to the server's now at response time (open break included).
